design: 深靛蓝袍、灰白内衬、窄褐色缘边，完整衣摆；全景左腰浅麻色素布印囊，铜印收在内。林道背景仅天空泛红，无可见火场，不露人脸。

images.prompt:
Edit the provided image, retaining its side-on left-to-right galloping horse action, exact camera framing and anonymous rider with head and face outside the frame. Full-frame 16:9 cinematic live-action historical film still.
Three coordinated changes:
1) Horse must be noticeably WHITER than input: luminous natural white short coat with subtle cool grey shaded areas, white mane and tail, only minimal dusty staining on lower legs. Remove the overall muddy grey-brown cast. Do not brighten the whole scene. It must look like a real healthy white horse photographed at dusk, not glowing or cut out. Very fine short flat-lying hair, smooth natural muscle contours beneath coat. REMOVE the unnatural embossed curled/etched woodgrain-like marks covering the horse in the source. Fine real hair detail, not carved or waxy skin. Eyes, nostrils and hooves remain naturally dark.
2) Upgrade the rider's costume to handsome, restrained late-Han period travelling attire: tailored deep indigo blue woven cross-collar riding robe with narrow muted brown edging, neatly layered light grey/off-white inner sleeves, practical tied waist sash and simple dark brown belt. A dignified traveller, no ornate armor, no modern costume. Replace ALL long torn strips and shredded hems with intact finished seams and a few clean overlapping robe panels flowing backward from speed. The hem may move in the wind but no dangling rags. Natural high-quality matte fabric with visible weave, convincing weight and folds, minimal wear at edges and a little travel dust. Well-maintained plain dark brown leather boots, no fantasy buckles or tall modern equestrian boot styling, no stirrups.
3) Same unchanged wooded mountain path at late dusk, near trees and ground streaking laterally from tracking, darker distant forest, only subdued dull red glow on clouds ABOVE the canopy from a faraway UNSEEN fire. NO visible flames, NO burning camp, NO orange ground/ridgeline fires. Preserve forest composition and sky positions. Cool-neutral ambient light, controlled natural color, not saturated or global yellow. Strong urgent gallop, anatomically coherent four legs, believable lifted dust, windblown mane. Photographic shadows, tangible fabric and leather, subtle grain, no CGI or game render, no painterly patterns, no text or watermark, no human face. In this full horse side shot, make the seal pouch visually CLEAR: exactly ONE plain warm light flax-grey cloth drawstring pouch, approximately palm-sized 7cm wide x 8cm high, hanging from a short secure loop DIRECTLY attached to the visible rider's left waist belt, slightly ahead of his hip. Entire pouch body visible outside the dark indigo robe, not hidden in folds or behind the arm. Strong natural tonal separation between pale pouch and dark clothing, clear closed gathered mouth and subtle handstitched seam. Small but readily identifiable at this wide framing. No embroidery, jewels, tassels, printed symbol or giant bag; no dangling bronze seal. Its bottom should remain near upper hip, not thigh or saddle. Keep rider's body cropped above shoulders, face offscreen, full horse and four hooves inside frame.
